activation.rule: every verdict carries thresholds_status; while it is PROPOSED_NOT_OWNER_APPROVED a verdict is advisory. Approval is recorded as a NEW file version (f0_activation_v1.json) that references this protocol hash; it can never edit this file

applicability.rule: a candidate is evaluated under the latest F version whose frozen_at_ledger_head.seq is BELOW the seq of the first trial_result of any trial the candidate's round contains. A later F version may additionally be applied to an already-seen candidate only as a second verdict; the more conservative of the two governs (retroactive changes can only downgrade)

attribution.benchmark_models: mkt + BENCH-BTC-TREND and mkt + BENCH-TSMOM (day series under EXEC-BASE); alpha must stay > 0 (E08, FRAGILE)

factors.btc: mean BTCUSDT gross label over the eligible rows of the day
factors.mkt: mean gross label over all eligible rows of the day (the unconditional-long control)

attribution.primary: the net alpha itself is the market-model alpha (A01, REJECT when <= 0)
attribution.series: the candidate PORTFOLIO day series over every evaluation day (mean net of the positions entered that day, cash = 0 on a day without entries), so timing skill (being out on bad days) can show as alpha while always-long exposure cannot

p2d0.rule: P2-F0 builds on P2-D0 (folds, benchmarks, horizons, Holm within hypothesis, grids); it never edits a P2-D0 file and can only add stricter conditions

p2rm0.rule: not imported, not resumed; any risk_inputs block in an evidence bundle is refused until a later F version binds a closed RM0 contract hash; P2-F0 itself refuses mixed quote currencies (fail closed)

p2x_v2.rule: net returns are EXEC-IDEALIZED / EXEC-BASE / EXEC-STRESS; fee, latency and stress ASSUMED, impact UNAVAILABLE; gross > 0 alone is never success; IDEALIZED never supports a positive verdict

economic.refusal_impute: refused EXEC-BASE positions are imputed at their EXEC-STRESS net, or at the minimum observed EXEC-BASE net of the window when STRESS is also refused

fragility.day_reference: iid Student t(4) day series with location = the observed alpha mean (the claimed edge) and a ROBUST scale = MAD / 0.7407 (the t(4) median |T|), so an outlier day cannot widen its own reference; crypto daily returns are fat-tailed, so a Gaussian reference would call honest fat tails fragile
day_statistics: alpha after removing the best ceil(10%) days (low adverse)
best-day share of the alpha sum (high adverse)
minimum regime alpha over regimes with >= 3 days (low adverse)
fragility.joint: Westfall-Young min-p over the statistics against the same reference; FRAGILE when p_joint <= alpha_joint
fragility.symbol_reference: within-day permutation of the per-position alpha contributions (net - beta_hat * m_d) across the positions of that day
symbol_statistics: top-symbol share of the total (high adverse)

implausibility.rule: INVALID_EVIDENCE (leakage audit required) when PSR(excess SR > max plausible) >= psr_trigger, or the Wilson 95% lower bound of the excess hit rate exceeds max_plausible_hit_rate
implausibility.series: MARKET-EXCESS: per position, EXEC-BASE net minus the mean gross label of all eligible rows at the same decision time, cluster-averaged by entry day (a bull market inflates raw Sharpe, leakage inflates excess)

inference.combine: p = max(p_stationary_bootstrap(a), p_hac_t(a)); the HAC t uses df = max(1, n_eff - 2) (one df for beta)
inference.null_label_rule: a null GROSS label is a position with an unknown outcome; it stays counted (refusal statistics) and is excluded from means; a null EXEC-BASE net is an execution refusal (section E06)
inference.primary_estimand: NET ALPHA: a_d = p_d - beta_hat * m_d over the evaluation days with factor data, where p_d is the candidate portfolio day value under EXEC-BASE (equal-weight mean net of the positions entered on day d, cash = 0) and m_d the COST-FREE unconditional-long factor (mean gross label of all eligible rows of day d); beta by OLS. mean(a) = OLS alpha. It charges every cost, credits timing (cash on bad days) and selection, and removes market beta, which is also most of the day-to-day noise
inference.two_stage_rule: in-sample = SCREEN (eliminate artifacts; liberal on significance, strict on integrity / economics / fragility beyond noise); confirmation = one pre-registered forward test with Holm across its set. Because the forward data are independent of the screen, the forward family-wise error is controlled however liberal the screen
inference.unit: day: positions are aggregated by entry day (clusters); a day is one observation

integrity.label_tail_rule: rows whose label window ends after the end of the last evaluation day are purged from every statistic and counted; the forward window may start only after the latest label end read by the in-sample evidence

min_n.rule: below any minimum P2-F0 computes no outcome statistic and returns INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (min_n); point estimates are not reported

multiplicity.dsr_trials: N = every ledger trial of the program excluding H-P2D-BENCH-v1 (pending, aborted, failed and inconclusive included); effective N = 1 + (N - 1)(1 - mean |rho|) with rho over evaluated trials only
multiplicity.global: Romano-Wolf step-down (studentized max-t, common stationary-bootstrap indices) over every evaluated trial of the round on the aligned portfolio day series
multiplicity.local: Holm across the evaluated trials of the candidate's hypothesis when every planned sibling was evaluated; otherwise Bonferroni with m = max(planned family size, ledger trials of the hypothesis)
multiplicity.pbo: not used in round 1: P2-D0 selects nothing by in-sample performance (no fitting), so CSCV would answer a question that is not asked; reserved
multiplicity.screen_rule: S02: the Romano-Wolf adjusted p of the candidate over the whole round must be <= screen_rw_alpha for FORWARD_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED (a raw-p screen alone forwards the best of 48 null trials far too often); the round must be supplied

items.f0: requires a positive COST-CHARGED net alpha (A01, REJECT) and EXEC-STRESS > 0 (E03)
items.finding: SUPPORTED is RELATIVE to the control: a removal / conditioning filter on a losing base (or a long-only filter that is flat in a falling market) can be SUPPORTED while losing money after costs (the project's 'loss-reducer, not an edge' and fee-blind-gate history)
items.proposed_d0_v2: SUPPORTED additionally requires executable net alpha > 0 under EXEC-BASE and EXEC-STRESS

items.f0: fixed (3 days at 24h, 2 at 4h; 1999 replicates; hash-derived seeds) plus the max(bootstrap, HAC-t) rule because each alone is anti-conservative at n ~ 14 (study C1)
items.finding: the stationary bootstrap's mean block length, replicate count and seed are unspecified: a researcher degree of freedom

items.f0: purges rows whose label ends after the last evaluation day (counted) and starts the forward window after the latest label end read
items.finding: label-tail contamination: 24h labels of validation day 28 (and 4h labels of its last 4 h) read day 29, the forward-untouched window; at 24h the whole of day 28 is unusable
items.proposed_d0_v2: purge the validation tail; forward window from day 30 for 24h trials

items.f0: Romano-Wolf over every evaluated trial (S02 screen, M01) and the deflated Sharpe with N = all ledger trials (M02)
items.finding: Holm only within each hypothesis: across 7 families the round-level family-wise error can approach 1 - 0.95^7 ~ 0.30; the global count is reported, not controlled

items.f0: plateau on the GROSS information effect (signal minus control, gross)
items.finding: the plateau rule (same sign for all grid neighbours) includes the HORIZON neighbour, but costs do not scale with the horizon: a genuine 24h edge can fail through a cost-negative 4h neighbour

items.f0: two-stage: in-sample = screen only; confirmation only by a pre-registered forward test of adequate length
items.finding: power: 14 validation days (13 usable at 24h) cannot detect any plausible edge; the minimum detectable net alpha corresponds to an annualized alpha Sharpe far above the plausibility bound (studies C5 / C6)
items.proposed_d0_v2: state that round 1 can only screen and reject

items.f0: E02 compares the absolute gross edge with the measured mean cost; A01 charges costs inside the alpha
items.finding: REJECTED compares the upper bound of the GROSS mean DIFFERENCE vs control with the 20 bps fee: a relative effect against an absolute cost (if the control also trades, costs cancel in the difference)
items.proposed_d0_v2: define REJECTED on absolute executable quantities

items.f0: proposes frozen values (top symbol share 0.5, best day share 0.5, remove best 10% days, top 1% positions) for PROVISIONAL and noise-calibrated joint tests for FRAGILE; owner approval pending
items.proposed_d0_v2: adopt or replace by owner decision

items.f0: deterministic fold rule blocks PROVISIONAL only; the fold minimum enters the noise-calibrated R11
items.finding: 'same sign in every validation fold' with two 7-day folds is weak against noise (about 1 in 4 null cells pass) and noisy for honest edges

items.f0: null gross / net values are excluded from means and counted; EXEC-BASE refusals are imputed (STRESS net, else window minimum) as a sensitivity (E06)
items.finding: how null labels enter the means is unspecified (they stay in the count)

items.f0: benchmark day series enter a regression (E08) for both horizons
items.finding: P2-D0 benchmarks are daily 24h rules; their comparison with 4h trials is undefined

p2d0_findings.status: documented findings and PROPOSED future versioned amendments (a P2-D0 v2 needs owner approval); no P2-D0 file is edited; P2-F0 applies its own stricter rule where stated

placebo.time_shift_resolution_rule: the shift test is UNDETERMINABLE when 1 / (window_days - 2 * min_offset_days) > time_shift_alpha (too few distinguishable shifts)

robustness.deterministic_rule: R01-R08 and R10 are the fixed P2-D0-style conditions (fold signs, remove-best, LOSO, concentration shares, tier, regimes, plateau, block sensitivity); at 14 days they fail often for honest edges, so they block PROVISIONAL only. FRAGILE comes from the noise-calibrated R11 / R12 and the economic / leakage checks
robustness.plateau_neighbour_rule: neighbours = planned cells of the same hypothesis differing in exactly one grid parameter (P2-D0 plan, horizon included). Statistic = GROSS information effect (mean over common active days of the signal gross cluster minus the P2-D0 control gross cluster): costs do not scale with the horizon, so net neighbour signs would test the cost structure, not parameter smoothness. Every neighbour effect must be > 0 and their median >= plateau_min_ratio x the candidate effect; a neighbour without a result, or a candidate without a positive effect, makes the plateau UNDETERMINABLE

status: FROZEN at P2-F0 (2026-10-06) before any Alpha outcome exists; numeric thresholds are PROPOSED and need owner approval before the first real evaluation

fragile: E04 not above the P2-D0 control
E07 no edge at 500 USDT depth
E08 explained by a trivial benchmark
E09 EXEC-BASE net <= 0 in the window
insufficient: S02 selection screen (Romano-Wolf adjusted p > 0.50 or round absent)
provisional: undeterminable E07 / E08 / R07 / R09 / A02
reject: E02 gross upper bound below the cost
P01 worse than the median random entry

meaning.FORWARD_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: passed the in-sample SCREEN: no integrity, economic, attribution, placebo-median or noise-calibrated fragility failure and net-alpha p <= screen_alpha; may be proposed for ONE pre-registered forward test; it is not evidence of an edge
meaning.FRAGILE: a positive net alpha that fails an economic-realism, benchmark, leakage-canary or noise-calibrated fragility condition
meaning.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: below the minimum sample, or the net alpha is not even suggestive (screen); absence of evidence, not evidence of absence
meaning.INVALID_EVIDENCE: the evidence itself fails integrity (binding, W3, window, PIT, duplicates, position rebuild, currency, implausibility); nothing about the strategy is concluded
meaning.PROVISIONAL: also passes the local (Holm) and global (Romano-Wolf, deflated Sharpe) multiplicity controls, the random-entry and time-shift placebos and every deterministic robustness condition in-sample; still requires the forward test; never a deployment approval
meaning.REJECTED: the claim of an executable edge is contradicted: net alpha <= 0 (exposure or costs explain the return), net significantly negative, gross cannot cover costs, worse than the median exposure-matched random entry, or P2-D0 REJECTED

verdicts.precedence: INVALID_EVIDENCE > INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE(min_n) > REJECTED > FRAGILE > INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE > FORWARD_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED > PROVISIONAL
